name: ClickSyncr for Kit – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr for Kit – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator connects your forms to Kit (formerly ConvertKit), so every form submission becomes a subscriber on your Kit form: automatically, with no code.

Works with your form builder

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Gravity Forms
  • Ninja Forms
  • Fluent Forms
  • Formidable Forms
  • Forminator

One plugin, one Kit connection. ClickSyncr configures each form right inside the builder you already use, and it connects your forms to 20+ other email marketing platforms too.

“Kit” and “ConvertKit” are trademarks of Kit, Inc. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Kit, Inc.

Why you’ll love it

  • Set up in minutes: paste your Kit v4 API key and you’re connected. No developers, no code.
  • Your Kit forms load automatically: choose which Kit form new subscribers join, right inside the form editor.
  • Map any field: send first names and your Kit custom fields straight from your form.
  • Built-in opt-in: add a consent checkbox and ClickSyncr adds the subscriber when a visitor ticks it, and sends nothing at all when they leave it unticked.
  • Subscriber status control: add to the Kit form or save as a subscriber only, per form.
  • Honest double opt-in: your Kit form’s own setting decides whether Kit sends its confirmation email, and the plugin says so instead of pretending.
  • No duplicate subscribers: Kit matches subscribers by email, so existing subscribers are updated and new ones are created, every single time.
  • A setup for every form: each form can sync to a different Kit form with its own field mapping, in every supported builder.
  • Sync health at a glance: an admin-bar menu shows every form’s Kit sync counts and the last error, if any.
  • Lightweight and fast: built to WordPress standards, so it never slows your site down.
  • You stay in control: you decide exactly what data is sent to Kit, and to which Kit form.

Learn more about the forms to Kit integration.

What you’ll need

  • WordPress 6.7 or higher
  • At least one supported form builder: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, or Forminator
  • A Kit account with a v4 API key (free accounts work)

Getting your Kit API key

  1. Log in to your Kit account.
  2. Go to Settings > Developer.
  3. Create a v4 API key.
  4. Paste it into the ClickSyncr for Kit – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator settings of any form.

Support

Need a hand? Browse the documentation, check the frequently asked questions, or contact us and we’ll be glad to help.

Kit

Connected forms send their submissions to Kit. Read more at Kit.

External services

Diagnostic sharing is on by default and can be turned off in the Advanced section of any connected form. It sends software versions, aggregate configuration and delivery counts, and random installation/device identifiers to Signls. It excludes contact/submission values and credentials. See privacy details.

This plugin connects to Kit. When you connect, refresh or open a configured form’s settings, it authenticates with your API key and requests the available lists, fields and account settings. A configured form submission sends the email address and the fields you map to your selected destination. A test submission sends the test address and configured fields. Subscription and consent settings determine whether a submission is sent.

Terms of service | Privacy policy

Privacy

ClickSyncr does not set tracking cookies or send visitor IP addresses to a geolocation service. If you map context fields, the mapped page URL, IP address, browser information or submission time is sent to Kit. Optional sender context adds the page, form, time and browser to the site owner’s notification email. API credentials, form settings and sync counters are stored in your WordPress database. Administrators can enable a local diagnostic log with redacted personal data. ClickSyncr does not receive your form submissions.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “ClickSyncr for Kit – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

After installation

  1. Edit any form and open its ClickSyncr for Kit – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator settings.
  2. Paste your Kit v4 API key, choose a Kit form, and map your fields (email is required).
  3. Save. Every submission now syncs to Kit automatically. Full guidance lives on the ClickSyncr for Kit – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Kit account?

Yes. You’ll need an active Kit account and a v4 API key to sync your subscribers. Free Kit accounts work.

Does this work with ConvertKit?

Yes. Kit is the new name for ConvertKit, and this plugin works with the same accounts and the same v4 API keys.

Which form builders are supported?

Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, and Forminator. At least one of them must be installed and activated.

Where do I find my Kit API key?

Log in to Kit and go to Settings > Developer, then create a v4 API key. Each builder setup guide shows exactly where to paste it.

Which fields can I map?

Map your form fields to the subscriber’s first name and to any custom field in your Kit account. New custom fields you create in Kit appear in the mapping list automatically.

How does the opt-in consent field work?

Pick a consent field (a checkbox, acceptance, or radio) from your form. When a visitor ticks it, the subscriber is sent to Kit; if they leave it unticked, nothing is sent at all, so nobody is added without agreeing. Leave it as “None” to use the subscriber status you chose for the form.

Does it work with Kit double opt-in?

Yes, exactly the way Kit designed it: your Kit form’s own incentive-email setting decides whether new subscribers must confirm. The plugin adds subscribers through the form, and Kit sends its confirmation email only if the form has double opt-in enabled.

Will it create duplicate subscribers?

No. Kit matches subscribers by email address: existing subscribers are updated and new ones are created.

Can I use different settings for different forms?

Yes. Every form has its own ClickSyncr for Kit – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator setup, so each can sync to a different Kit form.

ClickSyncr for Kit – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator Privacy

The plugin sends only the fields you map, and only to Kit. Nothing is collected by ClickSyncr itself. Read about our policy.
